svg.title: Night City: one glass tower for every active GitHub day
svg.desc: 17 towers for 17 active days between 2025-11-16 and 2026-11-17; lit windows equal that day's contributions (72 in total). A black superbike rides the neon road below. Data captured 2026-11-17.
svg.text: one tower per active day · lit windows = contributions that day
